name: Julie Calls Peyton from a Pay Phone
description: Julie stands at a pay phone, drops in coins, and dials Peyton's number. The phone rings, and she waits, listening to the tone, her eyes fixed on the receiver. 'Please be there, Peyton,' she says quietly.

Strack Sr. exits the car

Julie enters industrial building through front door

Strack Sr. threatens to deduct from driver's wages

description: Perched high atop a building, the bandaged figure of Darkman stands surrounded by stone creatures. His hands twist together in agitation as he speaks in a voice scarred by fire, uttering the words, 'I've been bad.' His gaze lifts to the sky, where inky clouds drift slowly across the darkened expanse above.

name: Driver Inspects Tire and Prepares to Sabotage It
description: The driver gets out of the vehicle and crouches down to examine the tire. He sees that the tire is not flat. Without saying anything, he reaches into his coat pocket, takes out a straight-razor, and moves toward the tire.

Driver retrieves straight-razor from coat pocket
Driver approaches tire with straight-razor

name: Eddie Black Confronts Threat at the Pier
description: Eddie Black stands inside a vast, empty pier building, lit by bare bulbs that cast long shadows into the darkness. He speaks sharply into a cellular phone, his voice firm and dismissive. A foghorn sounds in the distance. He leans against the roof of his car, parked in the center of the space. After ending the call, another man approaches and says, "They're drivin' up." Black nods and replies, "Get their pieces. We got a surprise for those fuckers."

Eddie Black receives a phone call about approaching adversaries
Eddie Black orders his associates to retrieve weapons

name: Strack Orders Buy on Kugerands and Responds to Condolences
description: Strack stands behind his power desk in his lush corporate office, speaking into the phone. He instructs someone to place a buy order on Kugerands. As he speaks, he acknowledges Franz's sympathy over his father's death, thanking him and stating that his father lives on as long as Strack Industries flourishes. A person nearby waves and moves further into the office.

Strack acknowledges Franz's sympathy regarding his father's death

name: Darkman Hurls Rick Into the Corner and Smashes the Wall
description: Rick flies through the air and slams into the corner of a partially demolished room, blood streaming from his face. Darkman's skeletal fists crash into the wall around Rick's head, smashing plaster with brutal force—SMASH! SMASH! SMASH! SMASH! Chunks of debris scatter as Rick whimpers, trembling. 'But I gave you the names. Where they lived... I told you everything,' he pleads. Darkman leans in, his eyes glinting. 'I know you did,' he says, voice soft. Then, closer, 'but let's pretend you didn't.' His clawed hand reaches forward and covers the lens. Darkness swallows the scene.
related_events: Darkman attacks Rick in a partially demolished room
Rick pleads with Darkman while injured
Darkman covers the camera lens with his claw

name: Peyton Emerges as a Couple Flees the Rain
description: Peyton steps out of a thick fog into the pouring rain, bandages wrapped around their body. Water soaks through the fabric as a man and woman burst from a well-lit restaurant, laughing, their voices sharp against the downpour. They hurry across the sidewalk and climb into a waiting taxi, which pulls away, leaving Peyton standing alone in the storm.
related_events: Peyton emerges from fog into heavy rain
Laughing couple rushes from restaurant to taxi

name: Strack Jr. Uncovers the Steward's Bribe
description: As Julie and the Stracks were leaving, Julie accidentally brushed against the steward and exchanged a few words. Strack Jr., who had been watching, approached the steward and demanded to know how much she had paid him. The steward, outraged, insisted he had no idea what Strack Jr. was talking about. Without responding, Strack Jr. seized the steward's fist, pried open his fingers, and revealed a hundred-dollar bill. He turned toward Julie's retreating figure and smiled.
related_events: Julie accidentally brushes against the steward and exchanges words
Strack Jr. confronts the steward about the bribe
Strack Jr. reveals a hundred dollar bill in the steward's hand
Strack Jr. smiles at Julie's retreating figure

name: Julie in the Elevator with Two Elder Women
description: Julie rides down in the elevator with two older women. Soft music plays from the overhead speakers. After a moment, she recognizes the song: 'I'm Afraid.' Its melody fills the space, slow and sorrowful. One of the women says, 'And you know he never said one bad word to that girl. He never done wrong by her. She's sure sorry now. He was a rare one.' The other replies, 'Well, you find someone who loves you, like Jim loved her, you shouldn't give 'em up so easy.' Julie stands still, her expression shifting as the words settle over her. The song continues. The elevator descends.
related_events: Julie and two elder women descend in the elevator
Julie recognizes the song playing in the elevator
First elder woman comments on Jim's devotion to the girl
Second elder woman advises holding onto true love
Julie is emotionally impacted by the women's conversation

name: Julie Climbs the Shadowy Stairs
description: Julie ascends a dimly lit flight of stairs that creak under her weight. Halfway up, she stops and stands still, listening. The sound of dripping water echoes in the silence. A faint scurrying moves just out of sight. She remains motionless for a moment, then continues upward until she reaches the landing. There, she knocks on the lab door, which begins to open with a slow creak.
related_events: Julie ascends shadowy stairs
Julie halts to listen on the stairs

name: Julie Knocks on the Lab Door

Lab door opens with a creak

name: Peyton Pressed About the Question
description: Peyton stands over the projected microscope image on the computer monitor. Yakitito announces that ninety-six minutes have passed. He asks Peyton if he asked the woman. Peyton, looking embarrassed, says not yet. Yakitito expresses disbelief, noting that the time has not changed. He suggests Peyton is afraid. Peyton interrupts, saying he did ask, but the woman said she didn’t know. Peyton stands and stretches. The telephone rings, and he moves to answer it, saying he’ll get it.
related_events: Yakitito reports elapsed time as ninety-six minutes
Yakitito questions Peyton about asking someone a question
Peyton admits he did not receive a definite answer

related_events: Peyton stands and stretches
Telephone rings and Peyton moves to answer it

name: Survive the Impact and Falling Debris
description: A shock wave slams a person onto the sidewalk. Moments later, flaming chairs and large bricks crash down around them, scattering across the street. Above, Peyton’s burning body hurtles from the sky, trailing fire as it descends toward the earth.
related_events: Shock wave knocks person to the sidewalk
Flaming chair and debris fall onto the street

name: Peyton's Fall
description: Peyton's flaming body tumbles from the night sky, streaking downward like a comet. Fire trails behind as she descends, silhouetted against the dark heavens. Below, a woman is thrown to the sidewalk by a sudden shock wave. Around her, a flaming chair and heavy bricks crash to the ground.
related_events: Peyton's body plummets from the sky in flames

name: Peyton Finds a Newspaper Reporting His Death
description: Rain hammers the alley, fierce and unrelenting, as a gust of wind tears away the cardboard shelter where Peyton crouches. Soaked and shivering, he watches floodwater swirl around a sewer drain inches from his face. A scrap of newspaper tumbles into the vortex, spinning toward him. He sees a photograph—his own face. The paper snags on a broken stick, the current holding it in place long enough for the headline to become clear: SCIENTIST DIES IN ACCIDENTAL BLAST/Body still missing. Peyton’s bandaged eyes widen. He does not move.
related_events: Peyton is exposed as wind carries away cardboard shelter
Peyton discovers newspaper with his own face near sewer drain
Headline reveals Peyton's reported death in laboratory explosion
Peyton reacts with shock upon seeing his own face and death report

name: Peyton Exposed in Storm-Flushed Alley
description: Rain hammers the alley with hurricane force, driving sheets of water from overflowing gutters. Wind tears through the narrow passage, lifting debris and hurling a flattened cardboard box into the rushing current. The water surges across the pavement, sweeping a scrap of newspaper in a spinning whirlpool around a sewer drain. Peyton, huddled beneath the now-vanished box, coughs and lifts his bandaged face. The newspaper scrap catches on a broken stick, pausing in the flow, its headline visible: SCIENTIST DIES IN ACCIDENTAL BLAST/Body still missing. Peyton’s eyes widen beneath the bandages.
related_events: Rainstorm intensifies in alley with strong winds and flooding

name: Strack Jr. and Strack Sr. Discuss Krugerrands in Limo
description: Strack Jr. and Strack Sr. sit in the back of a limousine, each reading financial papers. The two remain still and silent for a long time. Strack Jr. breaks the quiet, saying that gold Krugerrands are looking attractive. Strack Sr. asks if those are the ones with the chocolate centers. After another pause, Strack Jr. replies dryly that Krugerrands are gold currency, as his father knows. Strack Sr. comments that the word sounds like a frog trying to burp. He states that Strack Industries will stick with real estate. The limo glides into a rundown Texaco station.
related_events: Strack Jr. comments on gold Krugerrands as investment
Strack Sr. misunderstands Krugerrands as chocolate
Strack Jr. clarifies Krugerrands as gold currency

name: Limo Arrives at Rundown Texaco Station
description: The limousine turns suddenly and glides into a dilapidated Texaco gas station. The building is weathered, the paint peeling, the lot cracked and empty except for a single attendant leaning against the pump. Inside the car, Strack Sr. and Strack Jr. lower their financial papers. The engine idles. No one speaks.
related_events: Limo arrives at rundown Texaco station

name: The Gravedigger and the Limo Driver at the Gravesite
description: At the gravesite, the limousine driver watches the gravedigger leaning on his shovel. The driver remarks he didn’t see the man working earlier. The gravedigger replies that there was little to do—only an ear was found, no body. He adds that people sometimes expect a discount in cases like this, but the cost isn’t for the digging. It’s for the plot of land. The two stand in silence as Julie, nearby, buttons her coat and moves toward the limousine. She stumbles, overcome, and collapses into sobs. A priest steps forward and helps her up. Her face is wet with tears.
related_events: Limo driver observes gravedigger at burial site
Gravedigger reveals partial burial due to missing body
Gravedigger explains cemetery pricing based on real estate

name: Julie Collapses in Grief and Is Helped by a Priest
description: Julie buttons her coat and straightens herself, then walks toward the limousine. Suddenly, she falters, overcome by grief. Her steps waver, and she collapses to the ground, sobbing uncontrollably. She clutches at the grass, tears streaming down her face. A priest approaches and helps her to her feet. As she raises her head, her face is wet with tears, her expression filled with sorrow.
related_events: Julie attempts to compose herself before approaching the limousine
Julie is overwhelmed by grief and collapses
Priest assists Julie in standing after her collapse
Julie reveals her tear-soaked face showing deep suffering

description: Strack Sr. collapses onto a black cable at the service station as a bell rings continuously. Strack Jr. hears the sound and rushes from the car to his father's side. He finds Strack Sr. lying motionless on the ground and turns him over, revealing blood soaking his chest. Strack Jr. lifts his father's body into his arms as the ringing stops and a midnight blue Lincoln Continental screeches away into the distance.

Strack Jr. rushes to his fallen father

name: Man Pushes Shopping Cart Through Alley to Condemned Door
description: A man guides a shopping cart filled with charred electronics and broken lab equipment—beakers, tubing, computer parts, a walkman, a holographic cylinder, and a bio-press—down a narrow, twisting alleyway. The cart rattles over uneven pavement as pedestrians on the sidewalk give him wide berth; a mother pulls her child back as he passes. The alley tightens, turning away from the public street into a more secluded stretch. The cart rolls to a stop when it bumps against a steel door marked with a condemned sign. A bolt cutter is lifted from the contents of the cart.
related_events: Man with shopping cart moves through alleyway
Shopping cart collides with condemned door

name: Cutting Through the Lock
description: The shopping cart came to a stop against a steel door marked with a condemned sign. The man reached into the cart and pulled out a bolt cutter. He positioned the tool around the lock, squeezed the handles, and the lock snapped open with a sharp metallic crack. The door swung free.
related_events: Bolt cutter severs lock on steel door

name: Mother Pulls Child Away from Man with Shopping Cart
description: A man pushes a shopping cart along the sidewalk. As he approaches, a mother steps back and pulls her child close, moving them away from the path of the cart. The man continues forward, passing by without incident, and turns into a narrow alley.

He straightens and walks toward Taaf, moving through a room that shows signs of decay—peeling walls, scattered debris, and dim lighting. The space around him appears worn and neglected as he makes his way across it.

name: Durant Approaches with Newspaper
description: A well-dressed man walks hurriedly, head bowed against the wind, holding a newspaper. Strack Sr. hobbles toward him, moving with deliberate steps. The man lifts his head, revealing his face as Durant. He stares ahead as the two draw closer.
related_events: Camera shifts focus to a well-dressed man walking hurriedly
Strack Sr. hobbles toward the well-dressed man

name: Durant Emerges and Shoots Strack Sr.
description: Strack Sr. hobbles toward a well-dressed man holding a newspaper, his steps slow and deliberate. The man, standing with his head bowed against the wind, suddenly lifts his face—revealing Durant. A cold, malicious grin spreads across his features as he raises the newspaper, a silencer protruding from its folds. A muffled pop breaks the air. Strack Sr. jerks backward, clutching his chest, then begins to fall. From a high angle, Durant strides forward, passing the collapsing figure without pause, moving steadily away as the scene settles into stillness.
related_events: Durant reveals himself and shoots Strack Sr.
Strack Sr. is struck by gunfire and collapses
Durant walks past the falling Strack Sr.

name: Julie Hastings Meets the Stracks in the Lobby
description: Louis Strack Sr., an octogenarian with a stern demeanor, and his son, Louis Strack Jr., a well-dressed, imposing man in his fifties, enter the lobby accompanied by several aides. Julie Hastings, a young woman in a conservative business suit carrying a briefcase, rises from a chair and approaches them. She introduces herself as Julie Hastings from Pappas and Swain, representing them in the Von Hoffenstein negotiation. Louis Strack Jr. greets her politely and begins to introduce his father, but Strack Sr. cuts him off. He expresses displeasure at being represented by a woman and asks where Herb Gorson is. Julie responds that Gorson is occupied with litigation and assures him she is prepared. Strack Sr. scowls, then tells her to reduce Von Balibreaker’s price to sixty million and to close the deal if that figure is reached.
related_events: Julie Hastings greets Louis Strack Jr. and his father in the lobby
Julie Hastings introduces herself as legal representative for the Von Hoffenstein negotiation

Louis Strack Sr. interrupts Louis Strack Jr.'s introduction of Julie Hastings

description: After Julie Hastings introduces herself as the representative from Pappas and Swain, Louis Strack Sr. interrupts, questioning why a woman is handling the negotiation and demanding to know where Herb Gorson is. Julie explains that Gorson is occupied with litigation but assures him she is prepared. Strack Sr. scowls, clearly displeased, but does not reject her outright. He tells her to bring Von Balibreaker’s price down to sixty million, and if the offer reaches that amount, to close the deal immediately.

name: Rick Exits His Car and Approaches the Building
description: Rick's car pulls into the shadowy lot and comes to a stop. He opens the door, steps out, and closes it behind him. He walks toward the front door of his apartment building. A footstep crunches on gravel. He turns, glancing over his shoulder. The lot is empty except for his car. A shadow passes in the corner of his eye. He snaps his head toward it, but the street is still. Wind pushes a scatter of dead leaves across the pavement. He shudders, reaches into his breast pocket, and pulls out a small bottle of prescription pills. He opens it, takes two pills, and swallows them without water. Then he steps inside the building.
related_events: Rick arrives at his apartment building in his car

name: Rick Notices Strange Sounds and Shadows Outside His Building
description: Rick steps out of his car and walks toward the front door of his building. He hears a footstep on gravel and turns to look behind him. The car sits in the shadows of the lot. There is no one there. A shadow passes by and he snaps his head toward it. The street remains empty. Wind gusts across the pavement, sweeping dead leaves in front of him. Rick shudders, then reaches into his breast pocket, pulls out a small bottle of prescription pills, and takes two, swallowing them dry. He continues into the apartment building.
related_events: Rick hears a footstep on gravel and glances behind him
Rick notices a passing shadow and turns his head swiftly
Wind gusts blow dead leaves across the street
Rick shudders and attempts to calm his nerves

name: Rick Takes Pills Before Entering Building

Rick takes two prescription pills without water

Charred fragments of paper drift slowly through the air around her, floating past in silence despite the surrounding chaos.

Rain of utensils falls around Julie
Charred paper fragments float past Julie in slow motion

description: The flames behind Julie fade as night gives way to day. The burning building vanishes, replaced by rows of tombstones on either side. The charred paper drifting through the air slowly transforms into falling leaves. Julie stands motionless, her business suit shifting into a black mourning suit. The rain of cutlery ceases, and the world around her settles into quiet stillness.
related_events: Falling bits of paper transform into falling leaves in slow motion
Julie's business suit changes into a black mourning suit

name: Sirens Wail Amid the Burning Building
description: Sirens wail in the distance as flames engulf Peyton's building. Julie stands drenched in the downpour, surrounded by falling forks, knives, and spoons. Charred pieces of paper drift through the air around her. The sound of emergency vehicles cuts through the roar of the fire, growing louder as the smoke billows into the night sky.

related_events: Flaming debris falls around drowning man
Man sinks beneath murky water after groaning

name: Peyton Proposes at the Curb
description: Peyton, dressed in jeans and a sweatshirt, runs up behind Julie as she is about to get into a cab. He calls out for her to wait. She turns as she opens the door. Peyton tells her he’s been thinking and suggests they should get married. Julie freezes, half in and half out of the cab, and stammers about her career and liking her own place. Peyton points out they are practically living together and jokes that marriage just means answering the phone in the middle of the night and pretending it’s a wrong number for her grandmother. The cab driver leans out and asks if Peyton has a ring. Julie asks Peyton if he bought a ring. Peyton says no, he doesn’t have one. The driver whispers to Julie that Peyton doesn’t seem very committed. Peyton glares at the driver, who then starts the meter. Peyton starts to say he just now realized something, but Julie interrupts, saying she loves him and climbs into the cab, closing the door. As the cab pulls away, she leans out the window and says she’s not ready. She leans close to kiss him, but the cab moves into traffic. Through the rear windshield, Julie watches Peyton grow smaller in the distance. She looks back once more, but he is only a tiny dot on the sidewalk.
related_events: Peyton runs up behind Julie to stop her from entering a cab
Peyton proposes marriage to Julie at the curb

name: Julie Hesitates as Peyton Proposes
description: Julie stands at an intersection, signaling a cab when Peyton runs up behind her. As she opens the cab door, he tells her he’s been thinking—they should get married. She freezes, half in and half out of the vehicle, and stammers about her career, how she’s just starting at the firm, and how she likes having her own place. Peyton replies that they’re practically living together already, and jokes that marriage just means answering the phone in the middle of the night and pretending it’s a wrong number for her grandmother. The cab driver leans out and asks if Peyton has a ring. Julie turns to him, concerned, and asks the same. Peyton says no, he doesn’t have a ring. The driver whispers to Julie that Peyton doesn’t seem very committed. Peyton glares at the driver, who then starts the meter. Peyton starts to say he just now realized something, but Julie interrupts, saying she loves him. She climbs into the cab and closes the door. As the cab pulls away, she leans out the window and says she’s not ready. She tries to kiss him, but the cab moves into traffic. Through the rear windshield, Peyton grows smaller in the distance. She watches him fade into the city, looking back once more before he disappears completely.
related_events: Julie hesitates about marriage due to career and independence
Peyton jokes about the practical effects of marriage on phone calls

name: Cabbie Questions, Peyton Glances, Meter Starts
description: As Julie hesitated in the cab doorway, the cabbie leaned out and asked if Peyton had a ring. When Peyton admitted he didn’t, the cabbie whispered to Julie that he didn’t seem very committed. Peyton crouched down and fixed the cabbie with a sharp, hard stare. The cabbie straightened up, said nothing, and turned on the meter. The cab remained stopped at the curb as the conversation continued.

Peyton gives cabbie an intimidating glare
Cabbie starts meter during marriage discussion

name: Julie Declines Peyton's Proposal and Leaves in a Cab

Through the rear windshield, she watches Peyton grow smaller in the distance, until he becomes a tiny dot and disappears from view.
related_events: Julie expresses love for Peyton but declines marriage proposal
Julie attempts to kiss Peyton through cab window
Julie watches Peyton recede in distance from cab

name: Julie Finds Incriminating Memos and Makes a Call
description: Sunshine filters through the sheers, falling across Julie's shoulder as she sits on the bed, flipping through a stack of papers. Her expression darkens as she reads. She picks up the phone and dials. JULIE: Dale Gorson, please... Peyton enters, holding a mug of coffee, which he sets down on the papers in front of her. The mug leaves a brown ring on the top sheet. Julie pulls it away, smiles at him, then turns back to the phone. JULIE: Dale? Yes, Julie Hastings... I came across some memos while looking into the Von Hoffenstein deal—documents I wasn’t meant to see. They’re from the late Mr. Strack to someone named Claude Bellasarious. They show payments to members of the zoning commission. They look like payoffs. At the very least, they’re suspicious. I’d like to talk to Strack’s son first. Give him a chance to explain. She hangs up. Peyton moves behind her, kisses her, and gently massages her shoulders. She leans into him, eyes closed. After a moment, she stands, slips on her shoes, gathers her papers into her briefcase, and walks toward the door. Halfway out, she turns. JULIE: Bye. I’ll call you tonight. Maybe we can get together. She leaves. The door closes with a soft click. Peyton remains seated on the bed, looking around the quiet apartment, the lab beyond still and empty.
related_events: Julie discovers suspicious memos related to the Von Hoffenstein deal

name: Peyton Brings Coffee, Interrupting Julie's Work
description: Julie sits on the bed, reading through a stack of memos, her expression growing more troubled. She dials a number on the phone. As she waits, Peyton enters, holding a mug of coffee, and sets it down on the papers in front of her. The mug leaves a brown ring on the top memo. Julie looks up, startled, then smiles at him. She moves the mug aside and continues her call.

related_events: Peyton comforts Julie with a back massage and kiss

name: Julie Leaves and Peyton Stays Behind
description: Julie slips on her shoes, gathers her legal papers, and places them neatly into her briefcase. She moves toward the door, pauses halfway through, and turns to Peyton. 'Bye. I'll call you tonight. Maybe we can get together.' She steps out and closes the door behind her. The sound of the latch echoes through the apartment. Peyton remains seated on the bed, looking around at the quiet space, then glances toward the lab beyond.
related_events: Julie Hastings prepares to leave the apartment and says goodbye to Peyton
Peyton remains alone in the apartment after Julie's departure

name: Darkman Enters Julie's Room
description: The click of a lock breaks the silence, followed by a rush of wind through the open window. A deformed shadow creeps along the wall, then drops down over Julie’s sleeping form. Darkman, a figure wrapped in bandages, steps into the dim light of the streetlamp and stands motionless beside her bed, watching her. He reaches out slowly, his clawed hand brushing a strand of hair from her face. Julie shivers, turning slightly in her sleep. Darkman pulls his hand back and remains still, his breath faint in the dark room.
related_events: Darkman enters Julie's room and approaches her bed
Shadow crawls across the wall and descends toward Julie

name: Darkman Touches Julie's Hair While She Sleeps
description: Darkman stands over Julie as she lies asleep in bed. He reaches out and gently touches her hair with his clawed hand. Julie shivers in her sleep and shifts slightly. Darkman quickly pulls his hand away and remains still, watching her. He whispers, 'I need you,' his voice barely audible. The bandages on his face glisten faintly in the dim light.
related_events: Darkman touches Julie's hair and she shivers in response
Darkman whispers his need for Julie

name: Darkman Weeps for His Lost Face
description: Darkman stands in the dim light, tears seeping through the bandages below his eyes. He raises a gnarled hand and wipes at the damp cloth. In his other hand, a photograph of Peyton and Julie trembles slightly. He stares at the image, rubbing at the charred area that obscures his own face. His breath hitches, and he whispers, 'Peyton... give me my face back. Even I've got to have it, if it's only for ninety-nine minutes.'
related_events: Darkman wipes tears from his bandaged face
Darkman attempts to clear his burned reflection in a photograph
Darkman pleads for his face while whispering to Peyton

name: Julie Wakes Calling for Peyton
description: Julie suddenly sits up in bed, startled awake, and cries out 'Peyton' in emotional distress. From her point of view, the curtains flutter in the wind, and the room lies empty around her. She is alone.
related_events: Julie wakes abruptly from a dream calling Peyton's name
Julie sees wind-blown curtains and realizes she is alone

name: Resident Delivers Optimistic Line to Interns While Voicing Private Doubt
description: The resident walks down the hallway with a group of interns, speaking over his shoulder. He tells them to remain optimistic, inspire confidence, and talk to the patient about rehabilitation potential. As he speaks, he waves his hands in wide, empty circles. He mutters that personally, he gives the patient a nine on the buzzard scale. Just then, a loud warning tone blares over the public address system: 'Code Blue, Burn Unit. All doctors report.' The resident and the interns stop, turn, and hurry back the way they came.
related_events: Resident instructs interns on patient optimism protocol
Resident privately expresses low prognosis estimate

name: Responding to the Code Blue in the Burn Unit
description: The loudspeakers blare a warning: Code Blue, Burn Unit. All doctors report. The resident and interns stop in their tracks, turn, and sprint back down the hallway. Orderlies race ahead with a crash cart, rubbing conductive gel on defibrillator paddles. A nurse throws open a hospital curtain at the entrance to the Burn Unit, her face pale with shock. Medical staff pour into the room and freeze. The resident shoves through the crowd, pushing past interns and technicians, only to stare blankly at the empty space before him. Peyton's hydraulic bed stands exposed, its platform vacant. Bandages dangle, restraints hang torn, and E.K.G. wires sway in the wind. A gust blows through the open window, lifting the resident's hair as thunder rumbles overhead. Outside, storm clouds churn above the city.
related_events: Public address system announces Code Blue in Burn Unit
Resident and interns react to emergency alert and change direction
Orderlies rush crash cart down hallway toward Burn Unit

name: Resident Confronts Empty Bed in Burn Unit
description: The nurse yanks open the hospital curtain, her jaw dropping in disbelief. Doctors and technicians rush into the room and come to an abrupt halt, frozen at the sight before them. The resident shoves through the crowd, demanding to get to the front. He reaches the bedside and stares, blinking, at the empty hydraulic platform. Bandages hang loose, leather restraints are torn, and E.K.G. wires dangle in the wind. A gust blows his hair back as thunder rumbles outside.
related_events: Nurse violently opens hospital curtain and reacts in disbelief
Doctors and technicians enter Burn Unit room and freeze in shock
Resident pushes through crowd to reach front of Burn Unit room
Resident stares in confusion at empty hydraulic bed

name: Resident Sees Storm Through Open Window
description: The resident stood at the foot of the empty hydraulic bed, bandages and wires swaying in the air. A sudden gust of wind blew through the open window, pushing his hair back. He looked up. Dark storm clouds filled the sky, lit by a flash of lightning. Thunder crashed moments later.
related_events: Resident feels wind and looks up toward open window
Storm visible through open window with lightning and thunder

name: Darkman's Game of Show and Tell
description: Rick jolts awake in the dark after the TV cuts out with a crackle of electricity. The room is silent except for a gust of wind rattling the wooden shutters. A low, guttural laugh echoes from the shadows—inhuman, fire-scarred, and close. Rick scrambles up, voice trembling as he calls into the blackness. 'What do you want?' A distorted voice answers from the unseen: 'We're gonna play a little game. It's called show and tell. First, you tell me everything.'
related_events: Rick wakes up startled from sleep
Darkman emits chilling laugh from off-screen
Rick calls out into the shadows in hysteria
Darkman announces intention to play a game

name: Darkman Emerges from the Shadows
description: The room is dark and silent after the TV cuts off. A gust of wind rattles the wooden shutters. From the blackness, a charred and twisted hand slowly emerges. The fingers are skeletal, burned, and grotesque. One extended digit reaches forward and strokes Rick's face, cold and jagged against his skin. The hand then pulls back into the shadows. Rick stumbles, his breath ragged, as the presence looms in the dark.
related_events: Darkman's charred hand emerges from the darkness
Darkman strokes Rick's face with a deranged digit

name: Darkman Drags Rick Under the Bed
description: Darkman reaches out with a charred, skeletal claw and seizes Rick, yanking him violently under the bed. Rick screams, his legs buckling beneath him as he is pulled across the floor. The struggle ends beneath the bed, where Darkman looms over him, face wrapped in bandages, then slowly peels them back to reveal a mouth of burnt, crooked teeth.
related_events: Darkman drags Rick under the bed with a skeletal claw
Rick screams and collapses as his legs give out

name: Darkman Reveals Himself Under the Bed
description: Under the bed, Darkman moves face to face with Rick. He peels away the bandages covering his mouth, revealing a charred and twisted mouth with burnt, crooked teeth. In a fire-ravaged voice, Darkman says, "You always knew there was something like me under the bed."
related_events: Darkman confronts Rick nose to nose under the bed
Darkman reveals his burnt face under the bed
Darkman threatens to teach Rick how to scream

name: Arrival at the Riverfront
description: Two midnight blue Lincoln Continentals pass through a chain link fence and come to a stop along the riverfront. The cars sit in the misty foreground as eight men step out and stand beside them, their figures still in the damp air.
related_events: Two midnight blue Lincoln Continentals arrive at a chain link fence
Eight men exit the Lincoln Continentals

name: The Arrival of the Eight Men
description: A chain-link fence swings open, allowing two midnight blue Lincoln Continentals to roll through. The cars come to a stop along the misty riverfront. One by one, eight men step out and stand in the dim light. Robert G. Durant is impeccably dressed, his appearance sharp and polished. Rudy Guzman follows, wearing a powder blue polyester leisure suit, his nose visibly broken and misshapen from past fights in the Mexican boxing league. Skip Natick moves with a pronounced limp. Trumayne Johnson Mc Sam stands tall, a large black man with a calm and measured presence. Rick, a wiry twenty-year-old with slicked-back black hair, darts his eyes around in quick, nervous motions, staying close behind the others. His Adam’s apple bobs as he swallows hard. Smiley wears a fixed, unsettling grin. Pauly, middle-aged and balding, adjusts his suit pants over his protruding belly, then takes a swig from a bottle of Maalox, leaving a chalky ring around his lips. Corky Corcoran spits tobacco juice from between his wide-spaced front teeth, his blond hair tousled. They stand together as a group of fifteen dock workers approaches, their broad shoulders and heavy builds evident under their work clothes. One of the dock workers orders them to the car for a search. The eight men place their hands on the roof of the Lincoln. The dock workers pat them down, pulling weapons from their clothes. One holds up a gun, saying, 'Bunch a cuties.' Another adds, 'Put skirts on 'em, I'd marry one.' Laughter rumbles through the group. The eight men remain silent.
related_events: Robert G. Durant is introduced as a well-dressed man
Rudy Guzman is revealed with a history of boxing
Skip Natick walks with a pronounced limp
Trumayne Johnson Mc Sam stands with quiet composure
Rick displays nervous behavior while huddling behind others
Smiley reveals a permanent psychotic smile

name: Pauly Drinks Maalox, Corky Spits Tobacco
description: Pauly suppresses a belch, then raises a bottle of Maalox and takes a long drink. A ring of white chalky fluid coats his lips. Nearby, Corky Corcoran spits out a stream of brown tobacco juice from between his wide-spaced front teeth.
related_events: Pauly suppresses a belch and drinks Maalox
Corky Corcoran spits out tobacco juice

name: Visitors Searched at the Riverfront
description: Fifteen dock workers approach eight men who have just arrived in two midnight blue Lincoln Continentals. The dock workers, broad-shouldered and heavyset, order the men against the cars. The eight visitors comply without protest, placing their hands on the roof of the vehicle. The dock workers pat them down, pulling out knives and other weapons, which they toss aside with grins. One dock worker holds up a blade and says, 'Bunch a cuties.' Another adds, 'Put skirts on 'em, I'd marry one,' drawing loud laughter from the group. The visitors remain silent, eyes forward, as the search continues. When it's over, the dock workers step back, and the eight men straighten their clothes without a word.
related_events: Dock workers confront eight visitors at the riverfront
Dock workers conduct a physical search of the eight visitors
Dock workers make mocking remarks during the search
Eight visitors remain silent during the confrontation and search

name: Julie Arrives in the Shadow of the Limo
description: A midnight blue 1989 Continental pulls away from the curb. A cab pulls up in its place. Julie steps out and fumbles through her purse for the fare. The headlights of the departing limo sweep across her before fading into the night.
related_events: Julie exits cab and searches for fare
Limo headlights sweep over Julie

name: Peyton Ignites the Drinking Bird Device
description: Peyton crawls across the floor, dragging himself toward the table where the drinking bird bobs above the gas lighter. His charred hand reaches the base of the table and fumbles for the lighter. The beak of the drinking bird dips down and touches the ignition button. A spark clicks to life, growing in the stillness. The flame catches, silent at first, then spreads rapidly.
related_events: Peyton crawls toward drinking bird and gas lighter
Peyton's hand fumbles for the lighter at table base
Drinking bird beak contacts ignition button
Lighter ignites with spark in slow motion

name: Fire Engulfs the Lab and Triggers the Projector
description: A spark flares in the darkness, catching the edge of the drinking bird's beak. Instantly, one thousand lab sheets burst into flame. The fire spreads across the room, reaching a hidden slide projector. The machine whirs to life, casting images of Peyton and Julie onto the screen—the split-screen photograph of the two lovers flickering into view. The heat intensifies. The image wavers, the plastic melting, and then the screen erupts in flames.
related_events: One thousand lab sheets ignite simultaneously
Hidden slide projector activates and displays Peyton/Yakitito presentation
Split-screen image of Peyton and Julie melts and screen bursts into flames

name: Peyton Hurls Through the Wall in Silent Blast
description: A bright silent flash fills the room. Peyton's pupil contracts sharply. Intense blue light floods from behind, backlighting his figure and burning his shadow into the space beyond. The force of the explosion hurls him off his feet, tearing through the wall. His body spins upward into the night sky, limp and weightless. From the shattered windows and chimney of the building, blue light erupts, streaking into the darkness.
related_events: Peyton's pupil reacts to bright silent flash
Intense blue light backlights Peyton and casts his shadow
Peyton is thrown through the wall by explosive force
Peyton's body is flung upward into the sky like a rag doll
Blue light erupts from building windows and chimney into the night sky

name: The Sound of the Explosion Reaches the Ground
description: A moment after the blinding blue flash erupts from the building, the deep, thunderous roar of the explosion—KAAABOOOOMMMM—rolls outward, shaking the earth. The sound arrives late, following the silent fireball that tore through the walls and hurled Peyton’s body into the night sky. The force vibrates through the ground, shattering what remains of the windows and sending tremors through the still air.
related_events: Explosion sound reaches observer after visual blast

name: Peyton Rises from the Mud and Staggers On
description: Peyton collapses into an oily mud puddle as rain pours down. He slowly lifts his bandaged face from the muck, mud clinging to the torn fabric. His eyes, barely visible through the soaked wrappings, blink with effort. Trembling, he pushes himself up and struggles to stand. Once on his feet, he begins to move forward, staggering unevenly across the wet pavement.
related_events: Peyton collapses into an oily mud puddle during heavy rain
Peyton raises his bandaged face from the mud
Peyton struggles to stand and continues moving

name: Peyton Sees Julie and Staggers After Her in the Rain
description: Julie steps out of her brownstone apartment and opens an umbrella as rain falls heavily. Across the street, Peyton, drenched and unsteady in a ratty black overcoat, raises his bandaged face and locks eyes on her. His breath catches, and his eyes grow misty. Without hesitation, he begins to stagger through the downpour, struggling forward as he crosses the street toward her.
related_events: Julie exits her brownstone apartment and opens an umbrella
Peyton sees Julie from across the street and becomes emotional
Peyton staggers across the street to follow Julie

name: Peyton Clutches Julie's Shoulder and Reveals His Identity
description: Peyton reaches out with his scarred hand and grips Julie's shoulder. Startled, she spins around and recoils in horror at the sight of him. He pulls his hand away quickly, tucking it behind his back in shame. From within the shadows, a guttural rasp emerges: 'Juuuuulieeeeee. Heeeeeeeelp meeeeeee...' She freezes, her breath catching. He tries again, voice strained and broken: 'It's meeeeeee.' She takes a step back, hand rising to her throat, her expression a mix of fear and pity. He repeats, 'It's me,' but she turns and hurries away, disappearing into the rain-soaked alley.
related_events: Peyton reaches out with his scarred hand to clutch Julie's shoulder
Julie spins around and recoils in horror upon seeing Peyton
Peyton withdraws his hand and hides it in shame
Peyton speaks in a guttural rasp, pleading for help and revealing his identity

name: Julie Flees as Peyton Pleads in the Rain
description: Julie gasps, her hand flying to her throat as she steps back from the dark, bandaged figure. Rain pours down, soaking the street as Peyton reaches out, then pulls his scarred hand away, hiding it behind his back. His voice rasps, barely audible over the storm, 'It's meeeeeee.' He tries again, 'It's me.' But Julie is already moving quickly away, her umbrella tilting against the wind and rain. He stands alone for a moment before turning, both of them disappearing into separate alleys, swallowed by the shadows and the downpour.
related_events: Julie retreats in fear, hand protecting her throat, torn between fear and pity
Peyton repeats his plea, insisting it is him, but Julie is too distant to hear
Two figures separate and vanish into alley shadows during the downpour

name: Priest Comforts Woman and Walks Her to Car
description: The Priest places a consoling arm around the woman. They walk together toward a waiting car. The scene fades out as they approach it.
related_events: Priest comforts woman with consoling arm
Priest and woman walk to waiting car

name: Patient Transferred from Hydro Tank to Burn Platform
description: A severely burned man, his body swathed in bandages and dotted with tubes and wires, is lifted from a hydrotherapy tank filled with rippling blue fluid. Masked burn nurses carefully place him onto a hydraulic burn platform and secure him with restraints. The machine hums as it adjusts, holding the patient in place.
related_events: Burn patient emerges from hydro tank
Burn nurses strap patient to burn platform

name: Resident Demonstrates Pain Insensitivity on Burn Patient
description: The resident physician approaches the hydraulic burn platform where a severely burned man lies motionless, swathed in bandages, his body connected to tubes and wires. A group of interns follows closely behind. The resident explains that the man was pulled from the river with no identification and burns covering over forty percent of his body, the worst on his face and hands. He describes the Rangeveritz technique, then extends a steel pointer to indicate a spot above the patient's ear. 'We sever the spino-thalamic nerve here,' he says. Motors hum as the platform slowly rotates, turning the patient sideways. Without warning, the resident jabs a sterilized needle deep into the man's bandaged knee. The interns flinch, but the patient does not react. The needle remains in place for a moment before the resident pulls it out with a sharp motion. The patient lies still, face unreadable beneath the gauze, eyes closed, showing no sign of pain.
related_events: Resident physician presents unidentified burn patient to interns
Resident physician demonstrates pain insensitivity using sterilized needle

name: Resident Describes the Rangeveritz Procedure
description: The resident physician stands beside the hydraulic burn platform where the mummified patient lies, surrounded by interns. He explains that the man, pulled from the river with severe burns, has undergone the Rangeveritz technique. With a telescoping steel pointer, the resident taps just above the patient's bandaged ear, indicating the site where the spino-thalamic nerve is severed to block pain signals. To demonstrate, he jabs a sterilized needle into the patient's bandaged knee. The man shows no reaction. The resident removes the needle and continues, describing how the procedure cuts off pain but also leads to emotional consequences—patients become alienated, prone to loneliness and uncontrolled rage. He notes that without neural inhibition, adrenaline surges unchecked, giving the patient extraordinary strength, which is why leather restraints are necessary. As the resident turns to leave, the patient’s eyes snap open beneath the bandages—blue, alert, and fully aware.
related_events: Resident physician explains Rangeveritz technique to interns

name: Patient Rotated on Hydraulic Burn Platform
description: The hydraulic burn platform hums to life as motors engage, slowly rotating the mummified patient secured to its surface. The man, swathed in bandages with tubes and wires attached to his body, turns steadily, his head dipping downward until he is briefly upside down. The movement brings different sections of his burned skin into exposure, part of the ongoing treatment. The platform continues its measured turn, shifting him sideways before coming to a halt with a metallic clang.
related_events: Hydraulic platform rotates burn patient

name: Peyton Awakens with Fierce Lucidity
description: The hydraulic burn platform slowly rotates the mummified patient, his body swathed in bandages, tubes trailing from his limbs. As the platform clangs to a halt, his eyes suddenly open—blue, sharp, and fully aware. The face remains still, but the eyes betray a mind now awake, having heard every word of the resident’s explanation about severed nerves, unchecked adrenaline, and the rage that follows.
related_events: Burn patient's eyes open with fierce lucidity after hearing explanation

name: Peyton Prepares Coffee in the Lab
description: A clear fluid vanishes from the bottom beaker and instantly appears in the top beaker, now a steaming brown liquid. The liquid flows down coiled tubing and fills a coffee mug with a precise amount. Peyton reaches in and adds a dollop of half-and-half. He lifts the mug to his lips.
related_events: Fluid teleports from bottom beaker to top beaker and transforms into steaming brown liquid
Pre-measured liquid flows through coiled tubing into coffee mug
Peyton adds half-and-half to coffee
Peyton raises coffee mug to his lips

name: Peyton and Yakitito Monitor the 100-Minute Cell Experiment
description: Peyton calls out for the time. Yakitito responds, 'Ninety eight minute.' Peyton looks into the microscope. The cells pulse with life. A moment later, Yakitito announces, 'One hundred minute!' Peyton grips the table, his face breaking into a smile. 'The cells are holding, Yakitito.'
related_events: Peyton announces time to Yakitito
Yakitito reports time as ninety-eight minutes
Peyton looks into microscope
Peyton observes living cells through microscope
Yakitito reports time as one hundred minutes
Peyton expresses excitement upon confirming cell viability

name: Yakitito Presses Peyton About the Proposal
description: In the dim glow of the lab’s computer screen, Yakitito rummages through a drawer as the last light bulb flickers out. He pauses and turns to Peyton. 'So, did you ask her?' Peyton, still looking into the microscope, replies without looking up. 'Tonight.' Yakitito stops searching. 'This is unbelievable! You been saying tonight for weeks and still you don't ask her! Maybe I ask to marry you.' Peyton sighs. 'Your father would never approve of me.' Yakitito stares, confused, then shakes his head. 'No, I ask he if gbg marry you. I—' He trails off, then suddenly shifts focus back to the experiment. 'One hundred minute!' Peyton grips the edge of the table, eyes fixed on the pulsing cells through the microscope. 'The cells are holding, Yakitito.' A slow smile spreads across his face. 'Okay, Yakitito, you made your point.'

Peyton states he will ask her tonight
Peyton cites father's disapproval as barrier to marriage
Yakitito expresses disbelief at Peyton's continued delay
Yakitito misunderstands Peyton's relationship and offers to ask grandfather for permission

name: Yakitito Replaces Burnt-Out Bulb During Lab Power Failure
description: The lab is suddenly plunged into darkness as the overhead light fails. Yakitito announces the bulb is out and begins rummaging through a drawer to find a replacement. Meanwhile, Peyton instinctively glances back toward the microscope, his attention briefly returning to the experiment despite the disruption.
related_events: Light fails and lab plunges into darkness
Yakitito identifies light failure and prepares to replace bulb
Peyton glances back at microscope out of habit

name: Yakitito Challenges Peyton with Basketball
description: The lab is dim, lit only by the glow of the computer screen. Yakitito rummages in a drawer, then suddenly produces a basketball. He holds it in his hands and stares at Peyton. 'Dr. Westlake punch the wall! Dr. Westlake punch the wall!' he demands. Peyton, standing near the microscope, tries to redirect him. 'The function of sinusoidal currents in electrogenesis?' he asks, voice steady. Yakitito doesn't respond to the question. Instead, he winds up as if to throw the ball, then fakes a pass. His eyes remain locked on Peyton, waiting for action.
related_events: Yakitito demands physical action from Peyton as challenge
Peyton asks about function of sinusoidal currents in electrogenesis

name: Scanning Yakitito's Nose for Holographic Replication
description: Dr. Peyton Westlake stood behind a futuristic camera mounted on a tripod in the lab. He adjusted the device and triggered a series of rapid flashes—B-DEEEE! B-DEEEE!—as the camera captured Yakitito Yanagita’s nose from multiple angles. Three prints immediately ejected from the machine. Peyton fed them into a computer, where the image of the nose broke down into thousands of points, each assigned a numerical value. The data transferred to the Holographic Imaging Cylinder, a glass chamber wired to the computer. The cylinder glowed, and within it, a three-dimensional holographic model of Yakitito’s nose slowly formed, rotating in midair. Peyton studied the projection, then turned to the computer screen to verify the bio-press settings. The bio-press, a box lined with rows of small pins, powered on. A synthetic substance sprayed evenly over the surface, then the pins began to rise and fall, shaping the material into a precise replica of the nose. Yakitito leaned in. 'No more bunching. Looks perfect.' Peyton nodded. 'It looks like your nose. Down to the millimole.'
related_events: Dr. Peyton Westlake activates the holographic imager to scan Yakitito Yanagita's nose
Holographic Imaging Cylinder generates a 3D model of the scanned nose
related_occasions: Scientific Experiment Session In The Laboratory

name: Dr. Westlake Creates Synthetic Nose Replica in Lab
description: Dr. Peyton Westlake activates the bio-press, a device with rows of small pins controlled by a computer. The pins rise to specific heights, shaping a glistening synthetic material into a precise copy of Yakitito Yanagita's nose. The smooth surface hardens, revealing a detailed replica without any visible flaws. Yakitito examines it and notes that there is no bunching, calling it perfect. Dr. Westlake agrees it looks like his nose, down to the smallest detail, but expresses concern about the synthetic skin's ability to remain stable over time. The completed nose sits as a finished model, matching the original in form.
related_events: Bio-press constructs a synthetic replica of Yakitito's nose
Dr. Westlake confirms the bio-press output matches Yakitito's nose
related_occasions: Scientific Experiment Session In The Laboratory

name: Testing the Limits of Synthetic Skin
description: Dr. Peyton Westlake stands in the lab, watching the holographic image of Yakitito Yanagita's nose rotate inside the glowing glass cylinder. He feeds printed images into a computer, where the nose breaks down into thousands of data points, each assigned a number. Satisfied, he turns to the bio-press, a box of tightly packed pins that rise and fall under computer control. A synthetic substance sprays evenly over the surface, then hardens into a perfect replica of the nose. Yakitito adjusts his glasses, inspecting the result. 'No more bunching. Looks perfect.' Peyton nods. 'I don't know about perfect, but it looks like your nose. Down to the millimole.' He pauses, eyeing the synthetic skin. 'It's not the bio-press that worries me. It's the skin's instability. If it holds up, we're not just talking noses. Give me a victim and a photograph of his old face—he'll get a whole new face. Maybe even damaged skin tissue. Make him better looking.' Yakitito fumbles for the stopwatch around his neck. 'Ninety-eight minute and change.' Peyton turns toward the microscope. On the monitor, cells swim in a bath. He types in commands, and the screen splits: two rotating protein structures labeled 'EPIDERMIS' and 'SYNTHETIC EPIDERMIS STRUCTURAL MATCH' spin in sync. A sharp beep cuts the air. The synthetic molecule wobbles, then spins erratically. Through the microscope, the cells begin to fragment.

Yakitito Yanagita reports the elapsed time using his stopwatch

name: Examine Cells and Monitor Molecular Stability
description: Dr. Peyton Westlake looks through a microscope at cells suspended in an agar-protoplasm bath. He types data into the computer connected to the microscope. On the monitor, a readout shows the amino acid content, membrane potential, DNA content, and collagen congeners of the sample. The screen splits into two halves. On the left, a three-dimensional model of a natural epidermis molecule rotates. On the right, a corresponding synthetic epidermis molecule turns in sync. A beeping sound begins. The synthetic molecule wobbles, then spins erratically. Through the microscope, the cells in the bath break apart.

Computer screen displays biochemical analysis of cell sample

name: Dr. Westlake Observes Synthetic Skin Failure
description: A beeping alarm sounds in the lab. On the computer screen, the rotating image of the synthetic epidermis molecule begins to waver, losing synchronization with the natural epidermis model. The synthetic structure spins erratically. Dr. Peyton Westlake turns to the microscope. Through the lens, the cells in the agar-protoplasm bath are breaking apart. The fragmentation spreads rapidly. The synthetic skin has failed.

Beeping alarm alerts Dr. Westlake to molecular instability
Cells fragment under microscopic observation

name: Black's Joke and the Dock Workers' Laughter
description: The visitors are led into the circle of light cast by the car headlights, surrounded by dock workers who take up positions around Durant and his men. Eddie Black stands waiting, watching Skip, who limps forward. Black eyes him and says, 'Bum leg?' Skip replies, 'No leg.' Black responds conversationally, 'I was engaged to a girl with a wooden leg once.' Skip perks up, interested, and asks, 'Yeah? What happened?' Black says, 'I hadda break it off.' The dock workers burst into laughter. Black lets the moment play out, then cuts through the noise, shifting the tone.
related_events: Dock workers escort visitors into car headlights
Black makes joke about wooden leg to Skip
Dock workers laugh at Black's joke

name: Black Defies Durant with Three Threats
description: As the visitors step into the glow of the car headlights, guided by dock workers who take up positions around Durant and his men, Eddie Black stands waiting. He studies Skip, the man who limps, and remarks, 'Bum leg?' Skip replies, 'No leg.' Black responds conversationally, 'I was engaged to a girl with a wooden leg once.' Skip shows interest, asking, 'Yeah? What happened?' Black deadpans, 'I hadda break it off,' drawing laughter from the dock workers. After letting the moment pass, Black grows serious. 'Okay, let's cut the crap here,' he says, turning to Durant. He raises a finger. 'I ain't selling my property.' A second finger. 'Nobody muscles Eddie Black. Especially a bunch of fucks.' A third finger. 'Number three, if you guys is unha with that, which I can already is, then we can cutcha balls of f if that'll be more satisfactory.' His words hang in the air, broken only by the uneven shuffle of Skip's single shoe as he hops to keep balance.
related_events: Black confronts Durant with three demands

name: Smiley Confirms Safety Before Intervening

name: Intruders Ambush Peyton in the Lab
description: Peyton reaches for the phone, but a hand suddenly juts out from the shadows and clutches his wrist. A voice tells him not to bother. The phone rings once and then stops. A light snaps on, illuminating Pauly in the back of the lab, his bulky frame visible as he takes a gulp from a bottle of Maalox, white liquid dribbling down his chin. One by one, more lights come on, revealing Trumayne, Rudy Guzman, Corky Corcoran, Smiley, Skip, and finally Rick, who stands in the back looking pale. Peyton looks around in shock. Before he can react, Pauly’s fist slams into his face, knocking him across a lab table, sending glassware and equipment flying. Pauly grabs him, hauls him up, and slams him into the wall. Peyton slumps down, then struggles to his knees just as a gold cigar trimmer snips into view. A cigar is lit, and the flame reveals Robert G. Durant standing above him.

description: Peyton denies knowing about the memorandum. Pauly grabs him by the hair and slams his head into the wall twice. Durant steps forward, holding a cigar, and says the men are there only for the Bellasarious memorandum. When Peyton continues to resist, Durant gestures toward Yakatito Yanagita, whose head is covered in a plastic bag. An orange flash flares across Peyton’s face. Yakatito collapses in front of him, falling into view. Rick holsters the gun, pulls out a pill bottle, and swallows two pills without water.

name: Trumayne Finds the Document and Peyton Is Electrocuted
description: Trumayne emerges from the bedroom holding a coffee-stained document, waving it in the air. Durant nods in acknowledgment. Without hesitation, Trumayne and Pauly grab Peyton and force him toward two electrodes connected to a reservoir of blue fluid. They press his hands onto the metal. A powerful electrical current surges through his body. Peyton convulses violently, screaming, unable to pull away. His skin begins to peel back from his bones under the charge. Bright flashes of white light pulse through the room, illuminating Smiley’s grinning face. Peyton’s hands ignite into flames. The electrodes snap from the force and fall into the fluid, sparking violently. Peyton collapses to the floor, his burning hands smothered beneath him. Rick stands frozen, his face twisted in horror.

name: Forced Submersion in Electrified Fluid
description: After the electrocution, Durant turns valves on oxygen and acetylene tanks, releasing gas into the lab. The air fills with a volatile mixture. Nearby, the drinking bird toy dips repeatedly, its beak hovering near a flame, a potential spark waiting to happen. Durant crouches beside Peyton, speaking calmly, then signals to Guzman and Pauly. They grab Peyton’s legs while Pauly and another man seize his arms. Together, they lift him and force his head down into the reservoir of blue fluid connected to the electrodes. A surge of electricity courses through the liquid. Peyton’s body convulses violently beneath the surface. Sparks flare, then fizzle. The current shorts out with a final crackle, plunging the lab into darkness. Peyton goes limp, his body slipping under and then collapsing out of view as the gas hisses unchecked into the room.

name: Peyton Suggests Alkalinity Adjustment, Yakitito Reveals Failed Trials and Breaks Down
description: Peyton paces the lab, muttering about possible causes of cell instability. He stops and suggests increasing alkalinity to stabilize the cells, proposing a ten percent adjustment. Yakitito turns to a wall covered in lab sheets, pulls one down, and points to a cluster of entries. He says they’ve already tried ten percent, then twenty, then twenty-two—every level across the range. The cells still fragment at ninety-nine minutes. He stares at the stopwatch in his hand, then hurls it against the wall. He begins punching the wall repeatedly, shouting that the same failure has happened for months—three months ago, ten months ago—always at ninety-nine minutes. He slumps, voice breaking, saying maybe he’s a lousy scientist and should’ve listened to his father, should’ve gone to Anaheim, should’ve drowned in sake. Peyton watches, then calmly tosses a basketball into the air. It arcs toward the camera. Yakitito catches it. Peyton asks about thermionic emission. Yakitito throws the ball away, yelling that he doesn’t want to be calmed down. Peyton retrieves it, dribbles, and tosses it back. He asks again. Yakitito snatches the ball, shouts the answer—emission depends strongly on temperature—and hurls it at Peyton. Peyton catches it, pump-fakes, holds it just out of reach. He prompts again. Yakitito flinches, then recites the next part: temperature isn’t critical as long as it’s high enough and pure metals like tungsten or tantalum are used. Peyton tosses him the ball. Yakitito catches it. He stands still, breathing evenly. He blinks, looks at his hands, and says quietly, 'Amazing. It work every time.'
